sentences.text:
Opinion of the judge : Acquittal  (Vijeth .V)
 XXXIX ACMM, Bengaluru.
 : JUDGMENT :

The PSI, Kamakshipalya Police Station has submitted the present charge sheet against the accused No.1 and 2 for the offence punishable U/Sec.420 r/w Sec.34 of IPC.
2.

The brief facts of the prosecution case is as follows:
That on 16.10.2019 at 12.30 pm when Cw1 was sitting opposite to Bata showroom after consuming alcohol at Tirumala Bar, the accused No.1 and 2 by make believing Cw1 stating that they will drop near the house and when Cw1 is in intoxicating condition collected the gold ornaments and phone from the Cw1 and went away. As such Cw1 lodged a complaint as per Ex.P.1.
3.
A Case is registered in Kamakshipalya Police Station as Crime No.371/2019 for the offences punishable under Section 420 r/w Sec.34 of IPC.
After completion of investigation charge sheet has been filed against the accused No.1 and 2 for the above said offences and this court has taken cognizance for the above said offences.
4. The accused No.1 and 2 appeared through their counsel and they have been enlarged on bail.
Prosecution papers were furnished to accused No.1 and 2 as required under Section 207 of Criminal Procedure Code.
plea has been recorded, read over and explained the contents to accused No.1 and 2 in the language known to them, wherein the accused No.1 and 2 pleaded not guilty and claims to be tried.
5. In order to prove the case of the prosecution, it has examined CW-1 as PW-1 and got marked Ex.P-1 and Ex.P-2 documents.

After completion of prosecution evidence, statement of accused No.1 and 2 persons as required under section 313 of Criminal Procedure Code is dispensed as no incriminating evidence appeared against accused No.1 and 2.
6.
Heard arguments and perused the material on record.
2. What order?

8. My answer to the above points are as follows:
Point No.1 : In the Negative, Point No.2 : As per the final Order.
For the following, REASONS 9. Point No.1 : It is the case of the prosecution that, on 16.10.2019 at 12.30 pm when Cw1 was sitting opposite to Bata showroom after consuming alcohol at Tirumala Bar, the accused No.1 and 2 by make believing Cw1 stating that they will drop near the house and when Cw1 is in intoxicating condition collected the gold ornaments and phone from the Cw1 and went away.
10.
According to the prosecution PW-1 is complainant.
The prosecution has produced and got marked Ex.P-1 Complaint, and Ex.P-2 Spot Panchanama.
11. In support of the case of prosecution, it has examined CW-1 / Nagaraj examined as PW-1, who deposed before the court that he do not know the accused persons.
As the gold ornaments were misplaced in his home about five years back he has put his signature to a complaint prepared by the police marked at Ex.P.1.
He do not know the contents of complaint.
He has put his signature to Ex.P.2 panchanama at Kamakshipalya P. S.
No panchanama was conducted in his presence.
He do not know the contents of panchanama.
The accused persons have not taken any ornaments or mobile phone or documents from him by cheating.
Even though the PW-1 is treated as hostile and permitted the prosecution to cross examine the witness, nothing worth has been elicited from the mouth of said witness.
12. The prosecution has examined 01 witness out of its list of 10 witnesses.
As the complainant turned hostile as such remaining witness was dropped.
According to prosecution PW-1 is the complainant deposed before the court that he do not know the accused persons.
As the gold ornaments were misplaced in his home about five years back he has put his signature to a complaint prepared by the police marked at Ex.P.1.
He do not know the contents of complaint.
He has put his signature to Ex.P.2 panchanama at Kamakshipalya P. S.
No panchanama was conducted in his presence.
He do not know the contents of panchanama.
The accused persons have not taken any ornaments or mobile phone or documents from him by cheating.
Even though the witnesses PW-1 was treated as hostile and permitted the prosecution to cross examine the witness nothing worth has been elicited.
As the material witness has not whispered a single word against the accused No.1 and 2, as such the prosecution failed to prove the guilt of the accused No.1 and 2 beyond all reasonable doubt.
Hence, I answer point No.1 in the Negative.
13. Point No.2:

In view of my findings on Point No.1 in the Negative, I proceed to pass the following:
Nagaraju C vs Yashwantha on 15 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/76586819/
3 :ORDER:
Acting under Section 248(1) of Cr.P.C accused No.1 and 2 are hereby acquitted for the offences punishable under Section 420 r/w Sec.34 of IPC.
Their bail bonds and surety bonds stands cancelled.
Interim release of articles if any is made absolute after appeal period is over.
(Dictated to the Stenographer directly to the computer, typed by her, corrected and then pronounced by me in the open Court on this 15th day of March 2024).
(Vijeth .V) XXXIX ACMM, Bengaluru.
